limits.en: Full channel management, analytics, comment management and scheduling included at no cost

keyLimits.en: Requires a TikTok business or creator account for post scheduling; personal accounts lack scheduling

capabilities.en: Desktop channel management with analytics (views, follower growth, per-video engagement)
Post scheduling up to 10 days in advance for business/creator accounts
Comments manager for replying to and moderating comments from desktop

limitations.en: Post scheduling requires a business or creator account; personal accounts cannot schedule
Scheduled posts cannot be edited after the fact; they must be deleted and re-uploaded to make changes

reason.en: Equivalent first-party channel management and analytics dashboard for another short-video platform

unknowns: The official tiktok.com/tiktok-studio page renders via JavaScript and did not return readable content directly; facts here rely on a secondary source
Exact monetization tool details and full analytics feature list not confirmed from a primary source
